CustomField.description: Ordered list of columns displayed in the File Explorer datatable, separated by ";". Supported values are "title", "type", "size", "owner", "createdDate", "lastModified", "isLinked", "access" and "summary". Any other value is treated as a "Google File Version" field API name and is displayed only when that field exists. Leave blank to keep the standard layout.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Ordered list of File Explorer columns, separated by ";". "title" is always displayed first. A maximum of 7 columns is supported. Leave blank to keep the standard layout.
CustomField.label: File Explorer Columns
